reuse.why: Adds one guard helper used by all five provider link functions, but does not put it into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider already goes through and that already receives the sync source, external id and upgradingId.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the five identical guard calls are repeated, which a placement inside linkBankSyncAccount (or a wrapper around findOrCreateBank + link) would avoid.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount, but is invoked from each provider rather than from the shared link path, so a new provider has to remember to call it (it runs before findOrCreateBank, which is a reason to keep it ahead of the bank lookup).

scope.why: Only the guard and its five call sites change.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition of 'already linked'; the per-provider call is the only thing a maintainer has to keep in sync.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount (each call site invokes it rather than linkBankSyncAccount doing so)
